locator.section_heading: Key action statements 1A–1B — acute rhinosinusitis distinction and clinical diagnosis context
locator.evidence_summary: Supports documenting symptom duration and pattern, purulent drainage, nasal obstruction, facial pain or pressure, worsening pattern, associated symptoms, and relevant negatives without asserting viral or bacterial diagnosis.

evidence_records.source_organisation: American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery Foundation
evidence_records.document_title: Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis Update
evidence_records.population_qualifier: Adults with acute or chronic rhinosinusitis; the official web-page target-age wording is internally inconsistent and is retained as an applicability limitation.
evidence_records.setting_qualifier: Primary, urgent, outpatient, and ENT assessment and review of adult rhinosinusitis.
evidence_records.evidence_summary: Supports documenting symptom duration and pattern, purulent drainage, nasal obstruction, facial pain or pressure, worsening pattern, associated symptoms, and relevant negatives without asserting viral or bacterial diagnosis.
evidence_records.applicability_note: Exact for adult acute-sinusitis symptom pattern, reassessment, chronic-rhinosinusitis objective confirmation, modifying factors, polyps, and clinician-reviewed allergy or immune testing. It does not diagnose bacterial infection, recommend antibiotics, or order imaging.
